profile_text.body:
Zoom is a publicly traded collaboration software company, founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Jose, California (ticker: ZM). Its own site describes the company as offering a unified platform of tools including video meetings, Zoom Chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center, and events, positioning these as a way to modernize workplace workflows.

On the AI side, Zoom offers a product called Zoom AI Companion, which the site describes as built-in AI that summarizes meetings and automates next steps. The site also references a feature called ZoomMate, described as going further by generating assets such as decks and documents. Zoom AI Companion is categorized as a chat and general LLM product, with recording consent noted as a relevant consideration given its meeting summarization function.

The held facts indicate Zoom carries 175 tracked legal cases with California exposure, consistent with its California headquarters and status as a large public company. No MCP server registrations or SEC filings beyond standard public-company identifiers are present in the current data.
